senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; בכר)first-born (opp. פשוט, a plain, unprivileged son); also of animals.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 126a:2">B. Bath. 126ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ ופשוט</he>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:1:3">Y. Pes. X, beg. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה ב׳ והוה אכיל</he> was a first-born and yet did not fast (on the eve of Passover).—
<cite ref="Yevamot 16a:8">Yeb. 16ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. I, 3ᵃ bot. <he>ב׳ שטן</he> (play on <cite ref="S00794"><he>קטן</he></cite>) the first in obstinate dispute.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:9">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 42:37">Gen. XLII, 37</cite>) <he>הרי זה ב׳ שוטה וכ׳</he> is this a foolish first-born son! are thy children not my children? [<he>ב׳ שוטה</he> a first-born son by his mother, v. <cite ref="B00249"><he>בּוּכְרָא</he> I</cite>.]—

<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 8:1">Bekh. VIII, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>ב׳ לנחלה</he> a first-born with the privileges of a double share of inheritance (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:15">Deut. XXI, 15</cite> sq.), <he>ב׳ לכהן</he> one who must be redeemed from the priest (<cite ref="Exodus 13:2">Ex. XIII, 2</cite>). Ib. IV, 4 <he>ראה את הב׳</he> examined the first-born animal (and declared it defective); a. fr.—Pl. <he>בְּכוֹרִים</he>, <he>בְּכוֹרוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 18:10">Ex. R. s. 18</cite> <he>בְּכוֹרֵי מצרים</he> the first-born of Egyptian cattle; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 18:10">ib.</cite> <he>מכת בכורות</he> the plague of the first-born in Egypt; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:9">Num. R. s. 4</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 4:5">Bekh. IV, 5</cite> he who receives payment <he>להיות רואה ב׳</he> for examining first-born animals (as to bodily defects, v. supra); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:1:4">Y. Shek. III, beg. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>הבכו׳</he>, read <he>הבַּכִּירוֹת</he>.] Ch. <cite ref="B00249"><he>בּוּכְרָא</he></cite>.
